direction: About 14 s. A top-down still of the plane-table sheet. A pencil traces the first field boundaries as faint lines, without lettering. A slow drift across the paper. Ambience: pencil scratch, wind. Captions only.

still.prompt: Photoreal 16:9 top-down close-up, c. 1786. A sheet of laid paper is pinned to a wooden plane-table, with faint graphite lines sketching irregular field boundaries and hedge lines and no writing or letters. A brass sighting rule and a hand holding a pencil in a dark wool cuff rest on it, with a small brass compass at the corner. Soft overcast light. No text, no heraldry, no seals or devices.

captions.text: 1547: a family research note records a 1,000-year lease of 'Cydwin' from Sir George Herbert to Vaughan. The lease itself is not yet found (EV-0002).
1552–1824: a family research note gives the holding as 'Cedfin / Cydfin / Ken fin Farm or Ty Mawr Farm' in Bute estate records. The documents are not yet produced (EV-0003).
